name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engines. Growing up near Suzuka Circuit, he spent countless hours watching races and absorbing the mechanical symphony of Formula One cars. After completing his technical training, Kenji joined a small engineering firm specializing in precision machining. His meticulous attention to detail and innovative problem-solving skills quickly set him apart. 

Kenji's commitment to precision and his deep understanding of materials make him an invaluable asset to ALL-INKL.COM Münnich Motorsport. He approaches every task with unwavering dedication, ensuring that each component meets the highest standards of performance and reliability. Kenji's colleagues know him as the man who can fix anything, a testament to his ingenuity and experience.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Kenji has a wiry build and a focused gaze, reflecting his years of experience.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations
Has a collection of vintage engine parts on his workbench
Prefers to listen to classical music while working to maintain focus
